The '''MSP100 Pteropter hover pod''' was a airspeeder made by Gallofree Aerial Products during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic War]] of the [[Rebellion era]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. It was the possible successor of the [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod]], made by the same company.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
